title: Binance Will List BENQI (QI)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list BENQI (QI) and will open trading for QI/BTC, QI/BNB, QI/BUSD, and QI/USDT trading pairs at 2021-11-15 08:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  QI  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for QI will open at 2021-11-16 08:00 (UTC) Note: Binance will only support QI AVAX C-Chain token deposits and withdrawals The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page What is BENQI (QI)? BENQI is a lending and borrowing protocol built on Avalanche. QI is the governance token of the protocol, which enables users to participate in network governance, earning rewards for providing liquidity and staking. QI Listing Fee: 0 BNB.
